Bihar ki rajdhani patna men biskoman men chana dal ki kharid-bikri se jure kathit vittiy aniymitta ke mamle men pravartan nideshalay (ED) ne rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke MLC sunil sinh se karib 8 ghante tak puchhtachh ki. tisri bar saman jari hone ke bad guruvar dophar sunil sinh apne vakil ke sath patna sthit ED daphtar pahunche the. isse pahle do bar saman jari hone ke bavjud ve pesh nahin hue the.
Kya hai pura mamla?
